Elections that cities and towns run themselves

Most of Maryland's 157 cities and towns elect their officers at their own elections, run under their charters and apart from the State Board, many in spring or in odd years. Some vote on the same November day but run the election themselves, and their results are on each town's own site, not in the Board's files: Takoma Park (mayor and council, ranked choice) and Ocean City (mayor and council) among them. Cumberland's and Hagerstown's elections are run by the county boards and are here.
